STEP 7 - Energy: Sweet corn, cooked, ~96 kcal/100 g. 60 g × 0.96 = ~58 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single small corn cob section on a large plate is plausible at about 60 g and under 60 kcal. The plate is mostly empty, so the total is low.
